description: Chaldean and Pythagorean letter charts, core number formulas, personal year/month/day, lucky/unlucky popular associations.
disclaimer: Lucky/unlucky numbers are popular-practice associations, not scientific. Label as traditional/symbolic entertainment.

chaldean_chart.note: No letter is assigned 9 in classical Chaldean; 9 is considered sacred.

reduction_rules.pythagorean: Reduce digit sums to a single digit 1–9, but keep master numbers 11, 22, 33 unreduced where tradition says so. Commonly reduce each name part separately then sum.
reduction_rules.chaldean: Often sum the whole name (or name-in-use) into a compound number first; many Chaldean practitioners do not treat 11/22/33 the same way as Pythagorean. Compound name number may be left as two digits for interpretation then reduced.
reduction_rules.y_treatment: Default for training data: treat Y as consonant (Personality). Note that some practitioners count Y as vowel when it sounds like one.

life_path.system: Pythagorean / Western (date-based; same digits as Bhagyank except masters)
steps: Reduce year by summing digits until single digit (keep 11, 22, 33 if appearing as intermediate total per school).
Add the three reduced parts; reduce again keeping masters 11, 22, 33.
life_path.example: Born 14 March 1991 → month 3, day 14→5, year 1+9+9+1=20→2; 3+5+2=10→1 → Life Path 1

steps: Map every letter of full birth name via chosen chart
Sum (Pythagorean: often per name then combine)
Sum vowels only (A E I O U; Y per policy)

personal_year.formula: Reduce(month) + Reduce(day) + Reduce(calendar_year) → reduce to 1–9 (masters optional)
personal_year.note: Personal year runs roughly birthday-to-birthday or calendar year depending on school; document which the app uses.

lucky_unlucky_popular_practice.disclaimer: Popular-practice associations for entertainment apps — not scientific, not predictive certainty.
